# T4.3 (TASKS.md) -- follower score reporting. When a StabilityScorer is
# configured, followers attach Stability = scorer.Score() to MsgAppResp and
# MsgHeartbeatResp (DESIGN.md §2.2); the leader records the latest score per
# follower in tracker.Progress (StabilityScore + ScoreReported), visible below
# via `status` ("score=N" is only printed once ScoreReported is true -- see
# tracker/progress.go's String()). Written first per the TDD convention in
# CLAUDE.md, before the raft.go/tracker changes landed.

log-level error
----
ok

# Cluster A: all three nodes configured with a constant stability score of
# 200/255 (stability.ConstScorer, wired in via the `stability-score` add-nodes
# arg added for this test).
add-nodes 3 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 stability-score=200
----
ok

campaign 1
----
ok

# The post-election append round already carried Stability on the followers'
# MsgAppResp, so both peers show a score. The leader (1) has no entry for
# itself here since it never sends itself a wire message.
status 1
----
1: StateReplicate match=3 next=4
2: StateReplicate match=3 next=4 score=200
3: StateReplicate match=3 next=4 score=200

# A heartbeat round re-confirms the score via MsgHeartbeatResp too.
tick-heartbeat 1

# Cluster B: a fresh 3-node group (ids 4,5,6) with no StabilityScorer
# configured at all. This is the T4.3 accept criterion: with the scorer nil,
# behaviour (including `status` output) is byte-identical to pre-T4.3 -- no
# "score=" annotation appears anywhere.
add-nodes 3 voters=(4,5,6) index=2
----
ok
